name: Edit a room and export a floor plan
description: Verifies a room can be edited and the floor plan exported.
steps: Select a room in the 2D plan
expected: The room updates and an SVG floor-plan file is downloaded.

name: Add objects and create custom furniture
description: Verifies standard objects and prompt-created furniture concepts can be added and edited.
steps: Open Design custom furniture, enter a custom item description, and create it
expected: The objects appear on the plan and the custom item is added with an editable size and position.

name: Manage floors and portable projects
description: Checks floor management and portable project file workflows.
steps: Add a floor and switch to it
expected: The floor selector updates, a JSON project downloads, and a duplicate receives a new name.

name: Adjust exterior and construction estimate
description: Verifies exterior customization and editable construction estimates.
expected: The exterior changes and the budget recalculates using the new rate.

name: Use the planner on mobile and remove an item
description: Checks mobile planning controls and safe item removal.
steps: Open the planner at mobile width
Select a room and delete it
expected: The planner remains usable and the selected room is removed.
